newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London shadow FTSE lower.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London shadow FTSE lower.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London lost their overnight momentum on Monday and tracked the FTSE lower in thin trade ahead of the Chinese New Year, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was off 6.47 points at 13,444.60 by 1555 GMT.
"We're still being led by the UK market, it's all a bit feeble," one trader said.

Overnight, the Hang Seng climbed 129.28 points to close at 13,451.07 as investors anticipated a steady interest rate outlook in the near term and a pick up in market sentiment in time for the Chinese New Year.
"People are reluctant to get involved ahead of the Chinese New Year," the trader said.
The main feature of the day's trading was some buying interest in HSBC Holdings, traders said.
HSBC Holdings was up HK$1.05 at HK$181.05 by 1555 GMT.
